datasource_item.source_question_text:
A Chinook salmon can jump out of water with a speed v0 and an angle 𝜃 above the horizontal. What is the speed of the fish when it is at the maximum height?
A. 𝑣0. [incorrect]
B. 𝑣0 cos𝜃. [correct]
C. 𝑣0 sin𝜃. [incorrect]
D. 0. [incorrect]
datasource_item.generated_question_text:
A tennis ball is launched with speed u0 at an angle α above the horizontal (ignore air resistance). What is the speed of the ball when it is at its maximum height?
A. u0. [incorrect] Explanation: This is incorrect because the vertical component of velocity decreases to zero at the top, reducing
the speed from its launch value.
B. u0 cos α. [correct] Explanation: This is correct because at maximum height the vertical velocity is zero, so the speed equals the
unchanged horizontal component u0 cos α.
C. u0 sin α. [incorrect] Explanation: This is incorrect because u0 sin α is the initial vertical component, which is not the speed at the
peak.
D. 0. [incorrect] Explanation: This is incorrect because although the vertical velocity is zero at the top, the horizontal velocity
is still nonzero.
